hypotheses: H1: a stable reverse-core vortex exists at the CT-35 operating point and the high numerical PDR is physical
H2: the high numerical PDR is an artefact of wall-layer or outlet/orifice treatment
H3: the high numerical PDR is selected by the initialization branch and is not a general operating state
no_assumed_absent_vortex: Absence of a vortex is H2 or H3 only if the arm data support it. It is not a premise of this study.
